appendix: Rule 10.3: The value of an expression shall not be implicitly converted to a different type
Rule 14.4: The controlling expression of an if-statement shall have an essentially boolean type
Rule 11.4: A conversion should not be performed between a pointer to object type and a different pointer to object type
Rule 15.5: A function should have a single point of exit at the end of the function
Rule 17.7: The value returned by a function having non-void return type shall be utilized
